description: Median rent or sale price and number of listings for one BTS/MRT station (within 1 km), one line, or one district or neighbourhood of Bangkok, overall and by bedrooms. Use it to tell whether a price is fair. Returns the bkkradar.com page.

bedrooms.description: Also give the median for this number of bedrooms; 0 = studio, 3 or more = the 3+ group.

lang.description: Language of the titles and links: en, fr, th, ja (Japanese) or zh (simplified Chinese). Use the user's language.

line.description: Line code or name ("BTS-SUK", "BTS Sukhumvit", "MRT Blue"), or a whole network: "BTS", "MRT".

station.description: BTS/MRT station name or code, e.g. "Asok", "Phrom Phong", "BTS-CEN".

name: area_stats
title: Median prices of an area
